outcomes_fixed_in_advance.reproduces: median E1 across blocks within 0.10 of 0.85 and every block inside [0.71, 0.98]
outcomes_fixed_in_advance.partly: median E1 inside the range but one or more blocks outside it; report per block, no pooling
outcomes_fixed_in_advance.fails: median E1 below 0.75; the claim is then restricted to the transformation classes of the eighteen analysed arrays and the boundary is stated in the abstract

rules: Blocks were formed from measurement presence and the platform validation flag only; no yield was read.
No block, pair or condition may be added, dropped or reselected after scoring begins.
Pairs whose full-block best is zero contribute to neither E2 nor E3 and are counted separately.
Blocks are reported individually; a pooled number appears only alongside the per-block values.
Small blocks are not pooled with large ones without stating the pair counts.
